Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority,

to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the

IS: 7610 (Part in) -1975 

Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
MACHINERY FABRICS, WOOL 

PART III SIZING FLANNEL 
0. FOREWORD 

0,1 This Indian Standard (Part III) was adopted by the Indian 
Standards Institution on '28 February 1975, after the draft finalized by 
the Wool and Wool Products Sectional Committee had been approved by 
the Textile Division Council. 

0.2 Sizing flannel is a plain/or twill woven fabric made of wool fibres 
only or blends of wool and man-made fibres. This cloth is imparted a 
soft finish on one side which partially conceals the weave. 

0.3 A series of standards are being formulated on machinery fabrics, 
Part I of which covers the general requirements and other particulars 
regarding marking, packaging, sampling and criteria for conformity of 
machinery fabrics. Since this part covers the requirements of sizing 
flannel, IS : 605f>1970* is being withdrawn. 

0.4 For the purpose of deciding whether a particular requirement of this 
standard is complied with, the final value, observed or calculated, 
expressing the result of a test, shall be rounded off in accordance with 
IS : 2-1960*. The number of significant places retained in the rounded 
off value should be the same as that of the specified value in this 
standard. 



1. SCOPE 

1«1 This standard (Part III) prescribes the manufacturing " particulars 
and other requirements of sizing flannel. 

2. MANUFACTURING PARTICULARS 

2*1 The manufacturing particulars of sizing flannel are given in Table 1. 



♦Specification for sizing flannel. 

fRules for rounding off numerical values ( revised ).

Notb — In case of flax, polyamide or high tenacity viscose rayon yarn in warp, 
the count of weft yarn and the weave of cloth shall be such arranged so as to have 
predominance of weft. 

3. REQUIREMENTS 

3.1 The sizing flannel shall conform to the requirements given in Table 2 
in addition to complying with the stipulations laid down in Part I of 
the standard. 

3.2 The sizing flannel shall be tested for the various characteristics by the 
methods specified in Part I of the standard. 



♦Specification for machinery fabrics, wool : Part I General.

AMENDMENT NO. 1 MARCH 1911 

TO 

IS 1 7610 ( Part II1>1975 SPECIFICATION FOR 

MACHINERY FABRICS, WOOL 

PART III SIZING FLANNEL 

FOREWORD 

This amendment is being issued to transfer the requirements in 
respect of the nominal count of basic yarn and threads per decimetre 
to Table 1 since these are the particulars meant as a guide to the 
manufacturers.

renumber the existing SI No. * (iii), (iv), (v) and (vi) J as 
SI No. ' (i), (ii), (iii) and (iv) ' respectively. 

b) Delete the Note.
